'''Tammaz''' is the eighth month in the [[Farede calendar]]. In most years, it is equivalent to the real world period from [[July]] [[July 7|7]] to [[August]] [[August 3|3]].  [[Feast of Fools]] occurs during this month (in [[Arad Doman]] and the [[Borderlands]]), the [[Genshai]] occurs on the 8th, and [[Mabriam's Day]] on the 18th.
